title: Audit weighted callee compatibility in the ordinary wrapper
body:
Adds only `research/weighted-wrapper-contract/`. For fixed additive automorphisms P,Q, the unchanged PR2808 ordinary-wrapper word works iff Q=P and P^2=I. Using Q=P also maximizes correct address pairs over all second callees. Weights (4,1) modulo 9 pass modulo 3 but fail on 5,832 of 6,561 pairs.

PR2808 already warns against arbitrary weighted substitution. New: the two-distinct-callee theorem, sharp error-image/agreement bound, and a family invisible at every lower prime-power precision. No defect in PR2808 or PR2899 is alleged. No new κ.

[Proof, exact receipts, source hashes and scoped handoff](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/bbf10e5254321a17910ff425be913ffb20e36203/research/weighted-wrapper-contract).

Base: 9ee73fecdbae9f892a6496dbdfae872217cf4601.
Publication parent: 95ff4e2dd396c505932a43ff7c1cdfdd94b8c867; guidance, selected record and consumed inputs unchanged.
Sources: PR2808 b00b58e0db823643364f705b530faac254e7b05b; PR2786 80df2062cef303c05ffe89bb54b87b6b371d1253; PR2753 7dba5452a4071a856a0b11cebdcd2d3b6bcd7659. Other file pins are in SOURCES.json.

Reproduce with standard-library Python 3.12:
```sh
python3 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/weighted-wrapper-contract
```
Expected: PASS_WEIGHTED_WRAPPER_CONTRACT no_new_kappa, ending PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed.

Passed: normal/optimized registered replay; 4,352,832 general-map and 303,876 weighted address checks; 15,075 unchanged-source addresses via 41 Boolean origin planes; eight tests covering wrong order/inverse/callee, source and typed-receipt corruption, emission and cleanup. Metadata, compilation and committed-byte checks pass. Remote complete tree equals the tested tree.

Scope: fixed additive word only. Weighted callees are finite endpoint oracles, not implemented suppliers. Written proofs are not formal-kernel proofs. Physical costs, full selected cold replay and inherited all-size/analytic obligations remain outside this audit. Seed 62; local-only claim and bounded overlap coverage in TASK.json.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review. Credit Nick Petalas (2808/2786), David Arias (2753), Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml (2697/2899), Sagar Thakrar and retained source authors. Apache-2.0.
